03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill for pulling the complete comment tree of a YouTube video, every top-level comment and every reply, with the thread structure intact.

The download runs on Swami's Mac with the free yt-dlp tool, either directly or through Swami's ytx shortcut, or on a Windows PC with yt-dlp in PowerShell (no API key, no video download). The resulting .info.json file is uploaded, and Claude does all of the processing: counts, a threaded text file, and the hand-off to a dashboard, table, or export.

Why it mattersYouTube lazy-loads comments and hides replies behind "show more replies". Copying by hand on the FORTH video captured 75 of 474 comments (about 16%), with whole reply chains missing and no way to tell. yt-dlp gets everything in one pass.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Ready commandsGives Swami the ytx one-liner, or the yt-dlp commands with the real video URL and a short folder name already filled in, ready to paste.
  • Full extractionPulls every comment and reply, sorted the way the YouTube page shows them (comment_sort=top), with no reply-depth limit.
  • StatsReports title, channel, views, upload date, the page's comment count versus the number extracted, top-level comments, replies, unique authors, and uploader replies.
  • Threaded textWrites comments-threaded.txt: threads ranked by total likes, replies in time order, uploader replies marked.
  • DashboardHands off to the vibe-dashboard skill: ideas credited to specific @handles, sections grouped by theme, plus a Method section with the command, counts, and date pulled.
  • Table viewOne row per comment with the @handle linked to the comment's permalink, text, likes, and a sentiment tag.
  • Raw exportSends the threaded text file, or a CSV or Excel file built with the xlsx skill.
  • FallbackOnly with Swami's OK, and only when yt-dlp and ytx can't run: a browser-console script loads and expands the comments for copying (partial: reply nesting is flattened).

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Complete treeEvery top-level comment and every reply, with parent links, in one pass.
  • No API keyNo YouTube API key, no Google account, and no video download.
  • Rich fieldsEach comment carries author, text, likes, timestamp, uploader flag, and pinned flag.
  • PermalinksAny comment can be linked directly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEOID&lc=COMMENTID.
  • Cloud can't reach YouTubeClaude's cloud workspace usually cannot reach youtube.com, and neither can a linked computer's sandboxed shell, so the download always runs on your Mac or PC, by you.
  • Counts driftThe comment count YouTube shows rarely matches the number extracted, because its counter drifts as comments are held or removed. Both numbers are reported.
  • Breaks with YouTube changesYouTube changes often break older yt-dlp versions; updating usually fixes it.
  • Fallback is partialThe browser-console fallback flattens reply nesting and may miss comments, so Claude offers it only with your OK, when yt-dlp and ytx can't run.
  • One video at a timeEach run covers one video.
  • New Windows portytx.ps1 1.2.0 was rebuilt from the Mac script and has never been run on a real Windows PC. Its built-in ytx -SelfTest checks its results against the Mac ytx.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Reply depthmax_comments takes five values: total, parents, replies, replies per thread, and depth. A depth of 1 silently discards every reply, so always pass all,all,all,all,all.
  • Wrong yt-dlp fileThe plain yt-dlp download needs Python 3.10 or newer, and the Mac has 3.9. Use the standalone yt-dlp_macos binary.
  • Gatekeeper blockIf macOS blocks it as from an unidentified developer, run sudo xattr -d com.apple.quarantine /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp.
  • Sort orderyt-dlp's default sort is newest first; the skill sets comment_sort=top to match the YouTube page.
  • Quiet runThe extraction can print nothing for a minute or more while it pages through comments. That is normal.
  • JavaScript warningA warning about a missing JavaScript runtime is safe to ignore for a comments-only pull.
  • No cloud retriesDon't retry the download from Claude's workspace with curl or another route; the network allowlist blocks it.
  • Linked shellA chat linked to your computer gets a sandboxed workspace there, not your Mac's Terminal. It has no ytx and usually can't reach YouTube, so you run the extraction yourself.
  • Transcript folderA ~/yt/<video-id>/ folder left by a transcript run without -c has no comments in its .info.json. Run ytx -c "VIDEO_URL" to download it again with comments.
  • Browser only if askedIn Nov 2026 a chat switched to the app's browser on its own when it found no comments. The skill now forbids that: Claude must ask first, since the browser route is partial.
  • Renamed uploadsUploads may have spaces and brackets replaced with underscores; the processing script's file match handles that.
  • ytx says yt-dlp failedYouTube changed again: run sudo yt-dlp -U, then retry the ytx -c command.
  • SmartScreenWindows SmartScreen may block a downloaded yt-dlp.exe with "Windows protected your PC". Choose More info › Run anyway.
  • PowerShell line breaksThe Mac commands use a backslash to continue a line; PowerShell doesn't. On Windows, paste each command as one line.
  • Reopen PowerShellAfter winget install, close and reopen PowerShell before yt-dlp is found.
  • Missing DenoIf extraction starts failing with a JavaScript-runtime error, install Deno (winget installs already include it).
  • Links with &On Windows the ytx command runs through a .cmd file, which may cut a link at & (for example watch?v=…&t=30s). ytx still gets the video, but a stray error line may follow; use the Desktop icon, ytx -p, or the youtu.be share link.
12Other RequirementsREFERENCE▶
  • A Mac or Windows PCmacOS 10.15 or newer with an admin password for the one-time install, or Windows 10 or 11 with PowerShell.
  • Code executionClaude's code execution ("Create and edit files") must be on to process the JSON.
  • File uploadUpload the .info.json file to the chat, unless the chat is linked and Claude reads it from your ~/yt folder.
  • Internet on the computerThe Mac or PC needs to reach YouTube, and GitHub for the first download of yt-dlp.
  • DashboardsThe vibe-dashboard skill must be installed to build a comments dashboard.

TermTopicDefinitionAppears inQty
yt-dlpToolsA free command-line tool that downloads videos and their metadata, including comments, from YouTube and many other sites.
TerminalToolsThe macOS app for typing commands; used for the install and extraction on a Mac (PowerShell on Windows).
ytxToolsSwami's command-line tool that wraps yt-dlp: a Bash script on the Mac and ytx.ps1, a PowerShell port, on Windows. `ytx -c` pulls a video's comments into a yt folder along with a threaded text file.
GatekeepermacOSThe macOS security check that blocks downloaded apps from unidentified developers until approved.
Quarantine flagmacOSA file attribute macOS adds to downloads; removing it lets Gatekeeper run the file.
sudomacOSRuns a Terminal command with administrator rights; it asks for the Mac's admin password.
.info.jsonDataThe JSON file yt-dlp writes with the video's metadata and, with --write-comments, its full comments array.
ThreadDataA top-level comment together with all of its replies.
PermalinkDataA direct link to one comment, built from the video ID and the comment ID.
Uploader replyDataA reply written by the video's own channel, flagged author_is_uploader in the data.
max_commentsSettingsyt-dlp's five-part limit on comments: total, parents, replies, replies per thread, and depth.
comment_sortSettingsyt-dlp's comment order setting; top matches what the YouTube page shows, new is yt-dlp's default.
Code executionClaudeClaude's ability to run code and create files, which this skill needs for processing.
Linked computerClaudeThe shell Claude gets when a chat is linked to Swami's Mac through the desktop app. It is a sandboxed workspace that sees only connected folders, not the Mac's Terminal, so it can read the files but can't run ytx or yt-dlp.
Cloud workspaceClaudeThe private Linux machine Claude works in; its network is allowlisted, so it usually cannot reach youtube.com.
vibe-dashboardClaudeSwami's skill that builds dark-theme, single-file HTML dashboards; this skill hands its data to it.
FingerprintClaudeA short code computed from the skill's files; it changes whenever the skill changes, flagging this page as out of date.
PowerShellWindowsThe command-line shell built into Windows 10 and 11; it runs the Windows install and extraction commands.
wingetWindowsWindows' built-in package manager; installs and updates yt-dlp with one command.
SmartScreenWindowsThe Windows security check that warns before running downloaded programs from unrecognized publishers.
DenoToolsA JavaScript runtime that yt-dlp uses to solve YouTube's JavaScript challenges.
